beats.script_intent: Open on the verified date and the sudden activation of Brazil's air-defense response.
beats.narrative_text: On May 19, 1986, Brazil's air-defense network was drawn into a night of unidentified aerial reports.
beats.visual_anchor: Brazilian night sky; institutional map or restrained radar-room reenactment

beats.script_intent: Place the event in Brazil, not in a generic UFO setting.
beats.narrative_text: The case unfolded over Brazilian skies, with the country's own defense and air-traffic institutions at the center.
beats.visual_anchor: Brazil map with restrained geographic locator; no decorative HUD

beats.narrative_text: CINDACTA radar operators detected dozens of luminous objects and triggered an air-defense alert.
beats.visual_anchor: Archival-style radar documentation or controlled radar reenactment

beats.script_intent: Make the response concrete without adding unsupported tactical detail.
beats.narrative_text: The alert moved the report from an unexplained sighting into an official response.
beats.visual_anchor: Air-defense operations room; hands, paper and radio detail

beats.script_intent: Show the first documented military movement.
beats.narrative_text: Aircraft took off from the Santa Cruz and Anápolis air bases with orders to approach and identify the objects.
beats.visual_anchor: Faceless 1980s-era aircraft scramble reenactment; Brazilian location cue

beats.script_intent: Keep the focus on identification, not combat or alien claims.
beats.narrative_text: The documented mission was to identify what the operators and pilots were seeing.
beats.visual_anchor: Pilot checklist, runway lights and distant aircraft silhouette

beats.script_intent: Transition from memory to preserved evidence.
beats.narrative_text: A pilot from Anápolis produced a report that is preserved in the National Archive's UFO fund.
beats.visual_anchor: Actual archival document only after rights and reproduction status are verified

beats.script_intent: Show that the archive is broader than one anecdote.
beats.narrative_text: The collection includes reports, questionnaires, photographs, drawings, videos and audio from the Air Force record system.
beats.visual_anchor: Archive boxes, document close-ups or verified archive interface

beats.narrative_text: The Archive says sixteen audios from the fund were released, including eight recordings of conversations among pilots, controllers and the defense system.
beats.visual_anchor: Audio waveform only as a literal archive representation; no fabricated transcript

beats.narrative_text: In the archive's own explanation, an unidentified object is not automatically an extraterrestrial object.
beats.visual_anchor: Archival definition card or restrained document typography

beats.script_intent: Separate the strength of the record from the weakness of the conclusion.
beats.narrative_text: The records can establish reports, detections and responses; they do not establish the objects' origin.
beats.visual_anchor: Split visual: document evidence on one side, dark unresolved sky on the other

beats.script_intent: Anchor the chronology in a primary record.
beats.narrative_text: The SIAN occurrence report contains May 1986 entries involving Anápolis and São José dos Campos, with pilots/controllers and radar references.
beats.visual_anchor: Verified SIAN report page with source identifier visible

beats.script_intent: Acknowledge uncertainty without turning it into a supernatural claim.
beats.narrative_text: That is the tension: the response is documented, while the phenomenon remains unresolved in this story's evidence boundary.
beats.visual_anchor: Empty horizon after aircraft lights fade; clearly dramatized

beats.script_intent: Return to the archive as the durable object.
beats.narrative_text: The event survives not as proof of visitors, but as a Brazilian institutional record that can still be examined.
beats.visual_anchor: Archive shelf, document folder and SIAN identifier

beats.script_intent: End the narrative on a precise unanswered question.
beats.narrative_text: What exactly crossed those skies is still the question; what was recorded is not.
beats.visual_anchor: Night sky over a geographically coherent Brazilian landscape

beats.script_intent: Use one restrained CTA after the payoff.
beats.narrative_text: Follow Because Of This Stories for the next case where the evidence is stranger than the answer.
beats.visual_anchor: Approved brand outro only; no new factual claim
